title: Turbocharger/Supercharger Intercooler Bypass Valve "B" Control Circuit/Open
shortDescription: PCM detected: turbocharger/Supercharger Intercooler Bypass Valve "B" Control Circuit/Open.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates turbocharger/Supercharger Intercooler Bypass Valve "B" Control Circuit/Open. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Boost performance reduced; avoid sustained high-load driving.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect intercooler bypass valve wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect intercooler bypass valve and clear codes.

faq.a: Short distances are usually fine; avoid heavy load.
Rare - the PCM needs a verified passing drive cycle to clear.

title: Crankcase Pressure Sensor 'A' Circuit Intermittent
shortDescription: PCM detected: crankcase Pressure Sensor 'A' Circuit Intermittent.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates crankcase Pressure Sensor 'A' Circuit Intermittent. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Possible PCV system fault; check for leaks before extended driving.
